title: Remand
summary: REM'AND, verb transitive [Latin re and mando.] To call or send back him or that which is ordered to a place; as, to remand an officer from a distant place; to remand an envoy from a foreign court.

inlines.v: REM'AND, verb transitive [Latin re and mando.] To call or send back him or that which is ordered to a place; as, to remand an officer from a distant place; to remand an envoy from a foreign court.
